claim: § The Deeper Principle: 'apparent discontinuities often dissolve when you find the right coordinate system' — ratio blows up at infinity, slope runs smoothly 1.0 → 0.0; and § Origin: one repeat-rate dial gives pitch, echo, slapback, rhythm and pulse.

pieces.what: One repeat-rate dial on a click train swept from 2 Hz to 400 Hz: rhythm becomes slapback becomes pitch with no switch — the listener marks where the boundary is heard
pieces.walks_up_from: a single click repeating once a second

pieces.what: Two knobs on one compressor, ratio and slope, driving the same transfer curve; the ratio knob's last stretch to ∞ jumps, the slope knob glides to 0
pieces.walks_up_from: the transfer curve of a 1:1 wire

pieces.what: The compressor shown three ways at once — musical, technical, mathematical — one control moving all three
